# Claude (Anthropic) Source Evidence

## Source Scope

This package is a curated 3:4 video adaptation for Auto Vibe Motion and Remotion scenes.
It keeps Claude-inspired color, typography, and editorial tone while revising web fixture scale and examples for vertical video composition.

## Included Fixture Files

- design-systems/claude/DESIGN.md
- design-systems/claude/tokens.css
- design-systems/claude/components.html

## Token Contract

`source/token-contract.report.json` maps TOKEN_SCHEMA bindings back to the committed `tokens.css` declarations.
`design-tokens.json` and `tailwind-v4.css` should stay aligned with the token stylesheet.
